title: Billing Center: promo + VAT + email receipt

files.content: "use client";import {useEffect,useState} from 'react'; export default function BillingChip(){ const [t,setT]=useState(''); useEffect(()=>{(async()=>{ try{ const r=await fetch('/billing/invoices'); const js=await r.json(); const open=(js.rows||[]).filter((x:any)=>x.status!=='paid'); setT(open.length? `${open.length} open invoice(s)` : 'billing: clear'); }catch{ setT('billing: —'); } })();},[]); return {t}; }

export function can(user:{role?:string} | undefined, perm:'manage_billing'|'view_invoices'|'manage_org'='view_invoices'){ const r=user?.role||'viewer'; if(perm==='manage_billing') return r==='admin'; if(perm==='manage_org') return r==='admin'; return true; }

// simple guard at top: if(!can({role:'admin'},'manage_billing')) return
Not authorized.
